scope: Close a genuine Ghidra-opened local ELF64 x86_64 analysis session without snapshot; verify binary_session open -> false, cleanup_pending false, and safe repeat close with no active session. No snapshot saving, multiple concurrent clients or inferior-process detach claims.
host: Linux VPS original MCP; direct installed REA 6.8.0 connector; no new workflow, provider or source edit

negative.case: close_binary on already-closed session, without any open target
negative.behavior: Idempotent no-op; binary_session still open=false and cleanup_pending=false

limitations: Scoped positive and idempotent negative on one local ELF target, not all provider platforms or concurrent session teardown.
Closing a session returned null rather than standalone retained Evidence; lifecycle validated by independent immediate binary_session reads.
No snapshot_path or overwrite behavior certified.
